message: The other day, I found myself feeling rather smug as the weather reports warned of a big storm heading our way. You see, I’ve spent years listening to my kids preach about preparedness, while I usually just stocked up on extra snacks. But this time, I actually had a flashlight, batteries, and a full pantry ready to go. I felt like a superhero—minus the cape, of course. Have you ever had a moment where you were finally the prepared one? 🍪
